title: PRE-REVIEW TO PEER REVIEW: PITFALLS OF AUTOMATING REVIEWS USING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated numerical peer review scores against ground-truth human peer review scores to measure systematic score inflation and mean absolute error across different paper quality tiers.

Correlating LLM-generated review scores with post-publication impact metrics such as Disruptive Index, Novelty, and Conventionality to identify a preference for conventional, incremental work over highly novel or disruptive research.
